title: Pretraining large language models with MXFP4 on Native FP4 Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2605.09825v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Why does full-pipeline FP4 training of large language models often diverge, even when forward activations and activation gradients remain stable? We address this question through a controlled study of MXFP4 quantization in transformer training, progressively enabling FP4 across forward propagation (Fprop), activation gradients (Dgrad), and weight gradients (Wgrad) while holding all other factors fixed. In full pretraining of Llama 3.1-8B on the C4 dataset, we observe that quantizing Wgrad is the primary driver of convergence degradation, whereas FP4 in Fprop and Dgrad alone introduces only modest additional token requirements. To interpret this behavior, we evaluate both structured and stochastic interventions under a controlled experimental setting. We find that stochastic rounding and randomized Hadamard rotations fail to stabilize training once Wgrad is quantized, whereas deterministic Hadamard rotations consistently restore

translated_title: 在原生FP4硬件上使用MXFP4预训练大型语言模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.09825v4 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：为什么大型语言模型的全流水线FP4训练经常发散，即使前向激活和激活梯度保持稳定？我们通过对Transformer训练中MXFP4量化的受控研究来回答这个问题，逐步在前向传播（Fprop）、激活梯度（Dgrad）和权重梯度（Wgrad）中启用FP4，同时保持所有其他因素不变。在C4数据集上对Llama 3.1-8B进行完整预训练时，我们观察到量化Wgrad是收敛退化的主要驱动因素，而单独在Fprop和Dgrad中使用FP4仅引入适度的额外令牌需求。为了解释这种行为，我们在受控实验设置下评估了结构化和随机干预。我们发现，一旦量化Wgrad，随机舍入和随机Hadamard旋转无法稳定训练，而确定性Hadamard旋转始终能恢复稳定性。
tldr: 本论文发现权重梯度（Wgrad）的FP4量化是大型语言模型全流水线FP4训练发散的主要原因，并证明确定性Hadamard旋转能有效稳定训练，而随机方法无效。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies weight gradient (Wgrad) quantization as the primary cause of divergence in full-pipeline FP4 training of large language models, and demonstrates that deterministic Hadamard rotations reliably stabilize training while stochastic methods fail.
